meta.title: About
meta.description: Mechanical wooden kits, automata, magic tricks, puzzle boxes, animatronics and kinetic sculpture by Shasa Bolton.

blocks.content:
Visit the Contraption Cart shopfront and interactive gallery in Sheffield, Tasmania. Explore moving sculptures, automata, marble runs, robots and animatronics, and try your hand at opening a puzzle box or ask to see a magic trick. Browse the shop for model engineering kits, mechanical toys, magic tricks and puzzle boxes to take home. Contraption Cart is the work of Tasmanian designer Shasa Bolton, creating original mechanical curiosities, interactive machines and custom animatronics. Visit in person or explore our online store.
 
2/66 Main st
Sheffield
Tasmania

Hello, I’m Shasa Bolton, the designer and maker behind Contraption Cart. I’m a mechanical engineer with a passion for mechanisms, craftsmanship, and objects that spark curiosity.

In my shop you’ll find a collection of mechanical creations including automata, puzzle boxes, magic tricks, and kinetic toys. Many designs are available either as fully assembled pieces or as DIY kits, allowing you to experience the joy of building the mechanism yourself.

Alongside my own designs, I take on commissioned work in mechanical sculpture, animatronics, and product design. Whether it’s a unique display piece, an interactive installation, or a custom mechanism, I enjoy turning ideas into working creations. You can see examples of my past projects on my Projects page.
